Меняет адрес, с которого вас видят сайты: Changes the address sites see you arrive from. You need it when a site opens but will not let you in: endless captchas, “access restricted”, a refusal at sign-up or payment. The client is carried inside the program — there is nothing to install and no administrator rights are needed.
Преграды две, и они разные. Обход снимае: There are two obstacles, and they are different. The bypass removes the first: your provider will not let you reach the site. Packets are rewritten and the connection gets through. The address you arrive from stays yours.
Вторая преграда — сам сайт. Он смотрит,: The second obstacle is the site itself. It looks at the address you came from and checks its reputation. Russian home ranges score badly with anti-fraud systems: a lot of bots and abuse come from them, and the low score lands on the whole range at once rather than on the individual offender.
Адреса WARP принадлежат Cloudflare, а че: WARP's addresses belong to Cloudflare, which carries a sizeable share of the whole web — its addresses sit very differently in those reputation lists. With the proxy on you arrive not from a suspect pool but as a Cloudflare client, and the very same check lets you through.
Страну он не меняет. Бесплатный WARP выв: It does not change your country. Free WARP exits through the nearest node, so from Russia the address will be Russian. What changes is the address's reputation, not the country: “not available in your region” cannot be got round this way.
Через прокси идёт только то, что вы в не: Only what you point at the proxy goes through it: a browser, a messenger. Everything else connects directly — or turn on “Send all system traffic through it” under Options. And keep the bypass running: Cloudflare has to be reached in the first place, and with the bypass the connection comes up first try, without it every other attempt.
